execution_log.action: 安装 test/requirements.txt 全量依赖时 torchvision dev 拉取 torch 2.15.0.dev,导致 torch_npu(基于2.13.0构建)加载失败

details.问题: test/requirements.txt 中 torchvision==0.30.0.dev20260902 依赖 torch==2.15.0.dev,与已装 torch 2.13.0(构建 torch_npu 2.13.0 所需)冲突,pip 自动升级 torch 破坏 torch_npu
details.解决: 终止安装,恢复 torch==2.13.0+cpu + 重装 torch_npu whl,改为只装 test_autocast.py 必需依赖(pytest/expecttest/hypothesis/parameterized/numpy1.26.4/Pillow/requests),跳过 torchvision/onnx/transformers 等无关大包

execution_log.command: docker exec pytorch-ttfhw pip3.10 install torch==2.13.0+cpu + pip install --force-reinstall torch_npu-*.whl
execution_log.output: torch 2.15.0.dev20260902+cpu -> 卸载;恢复 torch 2.13.0+cpu + torch_npu 2.13.0+gitf6fe160

failures.error: AssertionError: Scalars are not equal! Expected 0 but got 2. (autocast 缓存禁用后 dtype_cast_counter 应为0但实际为2)
AssertionError: Scalars are not equal! Expected 0 but got 1. (autocast 缓存全局性校验 dtype_cast_counter 应为0但实际为1)

problems_encountered.problem: 容器内 torch.npu.is_available() 报错 rtSetDevice execution failed (drvRetCode=17),默认 NPU device 0 对应物理卡 0 状态为 Critical(异常),无法初始化设备
problems_encountered.solution: 通过 export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 将物理卡 2(首个 OK 状态卡,跳过卡0 Critical/卡1 Alarm)映射为容器内 device 0,torch.npu.is_available() 返回 True 且 NPU 计算正常
problems_encountered.source: 构建后 NPU 访问验证

problems_encountered.problem: 安装 test/requirements.txt 全量依赖时,torchvision==0.30.0.dev20260902 依赖 torch==2.15.0.dev20260902,pip 自动升级 torch 2.13.0+cpu 到 2.15.0.dev,导致已构建安装的 torch_npu 2.13.0 加载失败(RuntimeError: Failed to load backend extension torch_npu)
problems_encountered.solution: 终止 pip 安装,用 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 恢复 torch==2.13.0+cpu,重装 torch_npu whl;改为只安装 test_autocast.py 实际依赖(pytest/expecttest/hypothesis/parameterized/numpy/Pillow/requests),跳过 torchvision/onnx/transformers 等无关大包,避免 torch 版本冲突
